title.narrative: Madagascar National Reserve Allocation for Cyclone readiness in 2023/2024 season

description.narrative: Support for household food needs through pre-targeting, list proposed by targeting committees and community validation.Support for the revival of market gardening (training in agricultural practices adapted to the CC, distribution of seeds and small agricultural tools, etc.) for vulnerable farming households located in areas close to water sources that can be used for manual watering in the event of insufficient rainfall. Support for the improvement of food availability and diversification of food products at the level of target households as well as in the commune of intervention by supporting farming households located in villages close to water sources with seeds for their market garden crops and small agricultural tools. These activities ensure food availability and diversification within the 2-month risk anticipation window. Unlimited and unconditional cash transfer support will be offered in two tranches to vulnerable households in the drought stress phase. Technical guidance will be offered to participating household heads on financial management. Awareness-raising on cross-cutting protection will take place at every gathering opportunity (targeting, preparation for cash distribution, during the cash distribution itself).
